message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now strips the accent marks from the title before passing it to the vendored `slugify`. I left `vendor/` alone, as you asked.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) call the same vendored `slugify` directly, so they still drop accented letters. I didn't change them because you only mentioned blog posts. The same one-line normalization would fix them if you want it.
